description: Save the owner's pricing rules for their assistant, in their own words (owner only). For example: ignore jobs marked discount, add 15% for a second-story deck, minimum $2,500. Send null or an empty string to clear them. quotes.comparables and quotes.draftFromVisit return them. The assistant applies them. Doing Work does not.

rules.description: The rules in the owner's words. Null clears them.

name: shops_setPricingRules
